name: project
description: A project: a repository or an area of work with its own goals

name: program
description: A program or command you can run

name: module
description: A part of a program's code with one responsibility

name: function
description: A function or class important enough to have its own page (rule D11)

name: script
description: A helper script, usually a check or a build step

name: skill
description: A Claude skill: packaged instructions for one kind of task

name: hook
description: Something that runs automatically on an event (a chat starts, a turn ends)

name: service
description: Something that keeps running in the background or in the cloud

name: data
description: Files or stored state that programs read and write

name: actor
description: Someone who acts: Giovanni or a Claude instance

name: process
description: A sequence of steps across several parts of the system

name: decision
description: A recorded decision (ADR) or a rule with its reasons

name: external
description: A device or outside service the system depends on
